paragraphs.text: A planeswalker type is any subtype used for the further classification of planeswalker cards.

Like creature types , they are generally not optional and are most of the time more flavorful than mechanically important. There are two cards that interact with the type as a whole: Deification and Leori, Sparktouched Hunter , while individual types have been referred to on singular cards, most commonly across the planeswalker deck cards. Planeswalker types served a function similar to the legend rule, the planeswalker uniqueness rule until that rule was removed as of Ixalan .

Each type is either the first, last, or sole name of the character. The card name also encapsulates the type, with three exceptions of The Royal Scions , Professor Onyx , and Grand Master of Flowers . Five cards have no associated planeswalker type: three are of the Emperor of Kamigawa, aka the Wanderer , and the other two are of the Unluckiest and the non-sapient Aetherspark .
